reason: Reviewed lifecycle hooks, the shipped skill and every reference, harness setup, CLI readiness and domain terms for the terminal-first delay and "Send questions to my devices". Every question waits its own ask_grace_seconds delay from its own registration before it reaches the devices, also while another question is already live there; the submitter sleeps without the admission lock, and an answer owner already watching a live question picks a later one up once its own delay has passed. An OpenCode form waits the same delay before it is registered, and a form answered or dismissed in OpenCode during the delay never reaches the devices. With "Send questions to my devices" off, ask refuses as question_notifications_off and send --reply refuses the same way, so no question reaches the devices on any route. The setting's explanation, the skill's hooks decision, its questions-off paragraph and harness setup say so; the paragraph no longer offers send --reply as a route that setting does not gate. No command, flag, readiness id, hook definition or protocol field changed.
